mobile.source: Official ROBOTIS robotis_mujoco_menagerie, pinned commit d8344c0dbe7a00208d0301111523dde65efc174a; resources and parameters are defined by provenance.json and the selected MJCF.
approximations: Base dimensions come from the axis-aligned bounding box of the pinned model's base and wheel units; shoulder height is a reference value for the default lift pose after grounding, and checks use the actual geometry and left/right shoulder positions.
Vendor wheel units, lift, both arms, joint limits and gripper couplings are kept; the free root is converted to planar X/Y/yaw for static layout, and wheeled navigation is not certified.
Rated payload 3 kg per arm, using the 641 mm wrist distance as a conservative recommendation; the combined dual-arm payload or peak payload is not used for single-arm acceptance.
The gripper housing mount point is only for fixed adapters and does not move with the fingers; the tool center point is an engineering reference, not a measured grasp calibration.
The upstream wrist merges part of the gripper inertia; replacement variants keep this wrist inertia, so the exact dynamics after replacement cannot be certified from it.
Where web specifications differ from the pinned model, the model's limits are kept; the lift model coordinate ranges from -0.5 to 0 m.

The original free-root initial position puts the wheel bottoms 0.1465 m above the zero plane; the derived model keeps the original coordinates, and scene assembly shifts everything down by 0.1465 m and records that offset.

resource_resolution: Paths in resources are relative to the pinned robot resource directory; distribution must supply these exact files. Hashes establish identity, not physical certification.

workspace_design.room: Propose bounded room dimensions and reasons; version subsequent changes.
workspace_design.tables: Variable count, dimensions, height, position and orientation; no universal count cap.
workspace_design.invariants: Real equipment scale, source quantities, physical interfaces and required operations.
workspace_design.clearance: Whole robot and tools, door/lid opening, loading, maintenance and required separation.
workspace_design.docking: Multiple docks per instrument/operation; either arm, shared lift.
workspace_design.compactness: Justify table sharing, dimensions and room extent; necessary clearance is not waste.

assistance: Reuse stock grippers. Declare task-specific adapters/replacements, arm, interface, payload and reasons. No second robot or undeclared powered assistance. Cooperative load sharing requires separate evidence.
delivery_stages: Static modeled mechanisms and coarse approach suggestions precede local tests and complete execution. None proves the next stage.
initial_state: Submission declares base pose, lift, arms, grippers, installed tools and all instrument/table poses; they are not a fixed central base.
